serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
MeridianOps Cloud Platform is a multi-tenant SaaS grants-management and governance/risk/compliance (GRC) platform used by federal agencies to track grant applications, disbursements, and compliance reporting. MOCP runs entirely within an AWS GovCloud (US) region and is built on a microservices architecture with per-tenant data isolation.

**Key capabilities:**
- Grant lifecycle tracking from application through closeout
- Automated compliance evidence collection
- Role-based dashboards for program officers and grantees
